beers.name: Athletic Brewing Cold Off the Press Pilsner
beers.description_excerpt: Experience a delightful twist on tradition with Athletic Brewing's Cold Off the Press Pilsner, an innovative collaboration with Graza. This smooth and refreshing pilsner is uniquely brewed with Extra Virgin Olive Oil, delivering a taste profile that will elevate any occasion. Crafted for the discerning palate, Cold Off the Press features a classic pils-style essence, infused with herbal, floral, and zesty lemon notes, culminating in an extraordinarily clean and dry finish. beers.name: Go Brewing Baked Pecan Pie Fall Brew
beers.description_excerpt: Experience the essence of fall with Go Brewing's Baked Pecan Pie Fall Brew, a delightful non-alcoholic creation that's perfect for cozy sweater weather. This limited release is a tribute to autumn, combining toasted pecans and dark brown sugar over a rich, deep ruby-red malt base. Crafted with real ingredients, including real pecans, brown sugar, and molasses, this brew offers an enticing flavor profile filled with notes of bread, cereal, and, of course, pecans. beers.name: Atmos Brewing Prospect Amber
beers.description_excerpt: Experience the rich heritage of craft beer with Atmos Brewing's Prospect Amber, an exceptional American Amber Ale now available without the alcohol. Crafted from premium Idaho 2-Row Barley and Caramel Malt, the malt profile brings a delightful balance of sweetness and body. beers.name: Go Brewing Fruitless Extra Pale
beers.description_excerpt: Experience the vibrant allure of Go Brewing's Fruitless Extra Pale, a non-alcoholic beer that perfectly balances flavor and refreshment without the guilt. With the delightful combination of Rakau, El Dorado, and Idaho 7 hops, this brew offers an explosion of tropical and citrus aromas paired with a juicy, medium-bodied finish. Fruitless earns its name by delivering the essence of a fruit-forward beer without a single piece of fruit in the kettle.
